summary: 10.0.41.07 Comprehensive 10-Issue Desktop Parity Fixes (KPI Refresh Layout, Master Charges & Bank Lookups, Sales Register Actions, Standardized Attachments, GL Freeze, Single-Row Filter Toolbars, Full-Height Table Expansion, Quotation F3 Bootstrapping, and Email Badge Acknowledgment)
highlights: 1. KPI Refresh Parity: Removed 58px height clamping and innerHTML wiping from KpiCardEnhancer/app.css, maintaining exact Image 4 layout on reload across all modules.

2. Master Charges & Bank Details: Added Master lookup category 'CHARGES'/'CHARGE' to Sales & Purchase creation; updated Record Payment to look up category 'BANK' preventing 'Loading bank details...' hang.
3. Sales Register Actions: Integrated '#sales-row-actions-menu' into Sales Register view, restoring purple '::: Actions' dropdown button functionality.
4. Standardized Attachment Panels: Replaced attachment boxes in Sale & Purchase creation with standardized Add/Replace, Preview, and Delete design matching Settings & Quotation Editor.
5. Header Badge Cleanup: Removed redundant v10.0.41.06 badge from top header navigation, preserving single source of truth under Profile footer.
6. General Ledger Stability: Fixed GL row click freeze by isolating flex containers, bounded viewport heights, and preventing layout oscillation.
7. Full Vertical Expansion: Expanded data tables down to footer across all registers, and increased visible dashboard items to eliminate empty bottom space.
8. Email Badge Acknowledgment: Added reset logic in CommunicationController and localStorage acknowledgment in app.js so email counter clears upon viewing messages.
9. Single-Row Filter Toolbars: Applied '.filter-toolbar-single-row' with nowrap alignment to all 5 Bank & Expense submenus.
10. Quotation F3 Async Mount: Made openQuotationEditor properly await NavigationRouter view loading with defensive checks and MasterService customer fallback.
